system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.
human:
Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Build a verifiable fixed-base articulated manipulator named SCARARejectE. The resulting scenario must make the following behavior testable: Hold a nonzero joint target while rejecting a finite-duration lateral load at the distal link. Represent the plant without omitting its structure. A 28 kg cylindrical base supports two revolute Z links of 0.48 m and 0.34 m followed by a prismatic Z carriage with 0.30 m travel; moving masses are 6 kg, 4 kg, and 2 kg. Three saturated joint-space actuators command the two rotations and vertical slide, with command magnitude bounded by 105 N.m-or-900-N. Encoders and the wrist wrench sensor record the response before, during, and after the load. Model gravity and self-collision between nonadjacent links. Apply saturated state-feedback control with integral disturbance rejection and a controlled 21.6 N disturbance middle-third disturbance. Run at 250 Hz for 16 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Acceptance is fail-closed. Require finite states, no self-collision, peak deviation below 0.18 rad, and recovery to the target band, primary tracking error below 0.032 rad-or-m after 10.4 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
